title: Swarm-optimized machine learning predicts poor recovery after general anesthesia
summary: In 1,128 patients from one hospital, a swarm-intelligence-optimized model with XGBoost as base learner and seven Lasso-selected variables reached test AUC 0.88 (F1 0.77) for poor postoperative recovery and AUC 0.84 on a second dataset from an affiliated hospital. The study is retrospective and the external cohort size is not stated in the abstract.
ai_technology: Swarm-intelligence machine learning with XGBoost base learner and Lasso variable selection
organization: Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital; Zhejiang University

evidence.tested: Retrospective test split and external validation on a second hospital dataset.
evidence.unknown: Cohort size of the external set and effect on care are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted poor recovery (hypothermia, delayed PACU discharge or awakening) from clinical variables.
